verdict.rationale: Rev AI is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. Jobs are submitted and transcripts retrieved through the Asynchronous API using commands, completion is signalled programmatically via webhooks, and SDKs support scripted integration. That makes unattended automation and pipeline use the product's native mode. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guidance or examples, an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
